description: The Pakistan General Insurance Company Limited (PGI) is a Pakistani general insurer incorporated in 1947, the year of independence, and describes itself as protecting Pakistan for more than 75 years. It writes motor, property and fire, marine, engineering, bonds and guarantees, and corporate and miscellaneous general insurance. The company suspended business and was revived in the last quarter of 2024 with a strengthened capital structure; its chairman describes it as having re-entered the market with rebuilt governance, professional management and upgraded systems.
sourceNote: Company website (pgi.com.pk: 'incorporated in 1947' heritage statement, the product lines listed, SECP regulation, and the chairman's message describing the revival of the company in the last quarter of 2024), read 2026-10-17. No head office address, telephone number or chief executive is published on the pages read; the only executive named is the chief financial officer and deputy managing director, so ceo is null.
